description: Golden fingerprints of public-only v2 outputs, frozen so that additive v3 work cannot silently change the v2 scoring path. Scores are rounded to GOLDEN_DECIMALS places before fingerprinting; see tests/test_v2_golden.py. Private query outputs are intentionally excluded.
reanchor_note: Re-recorded after two reproducibility defects were fixed. (1) The fingerprint hashed full-precision floats, so it reproduced only on the machine that captured it; scores are now rounded to GOLDEN_DECIMALS places first. (2) best_reference_molecule was selected with an unstable argsort, so reference ligands tied at the maximum similarity were ordered by whichever SIMD path NumPy chose for the host CPU; 3 of 272 rows named a different, exactly-tied reference on different machines. The sort is now stable and no score changed. Before re-recording, the v2 outputs were recomputed under requirements.lock at 1f6173c, the commit that froze this golden, and at 61fc130, and were byte-identical, so v3 work has not changed the v2 scoring path. The reference-coverage digest is unchanged from its original capture at 2ed4684.
